name: soundslikeme
description: Builds a personal VOICE.md profile from 5-10 authentic human-written samples (captions, DMs, transcripts, emails) and rewrites AI drafts to match your real cadence, phrasing, and vocabulary.

interface.shortDescription: Extracts your real voice from 5-10 human samples into VOICE.md and rewrites drafts to match.
interface.longDescription: Builds a personal VOICE.md profile from 5-10 authentic human-written samples (captions, DMs, transcripts, emails) and rewrites AI drafts to match your real cadence, phrasing, and vocabulary.
defaultPrompt: Build my VOICE.md from these 6 posts I wrote myself
Rewrite this draft using my VOICE.md so it actually sounds like me
